lesson.title: 6.4 The train leaves from platform four
lesson.unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
lesson.lesson_title: The train leaves from platform four
lesson.sub_lesson_title: The train leaves from platform four
lesson.goal: Say where a train or an airplane leaves from and ask which platform or gate (The train leaves from platform four. Which gate is it? It's gate nine.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.4 More Places to Visit: A1 adds the airport and travel points; A1+ 6.4 finds the platform or gate. The new items are platform and gate with a number (platform four, gate twelve), leaves from after A1 6.12's leaves (The train leaves from platform four.) and the question Which platform is it? / Which gate is it?. Every photo has one big sign with one number and no other digit; platform seven and gate twelve keep their sign outside the centered 4:5 crop, so they are never in a four-picture card.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 6.2 train and airplane; A1 6.4 airport; A1 6.12 leaves; A1 numbers to twenty.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Stress PLAT-form; link leaves from (LEEVZ-from). Do not require native-like speed.
